Emergency & Rapid Laboratory Testing in White Rock, TX

When you are facing a medical crisis or need fast diagnostic answers, waiting days for an outside lab is not an option. At ER of White Rock, our 24/7 freestanding ER features a fully equipped, COLA-certified on-site laboratory. Whether you require life-saving cardiac panels, complex blood cultures, or rapid viral testing, our board-certified physicians rely on our in-house technology to deliver precise results in minutes. Experience highly capable diagnostic medicine with minimal wait times right here in East Dallas.

Get Laboratory Testing Services Now

Why Choose ER of White Rock for Diagnostic Testing?

We do not send your critical samples across the city to a third-party facility. By processing your tests on-site, we eliminate delays and accelerate your treatment. Here is why our facility is the top choice for rapid testing:
  • COLA-Certified Laboratory: Our facility adheres to the strictest national quality control standards, ensuring your results are flawless and highly accurate.
  • Results in Minutes, Not Days: We specialize in STAT emergency testing. For most critical panels, your physician will have the data they need to treat you within one hour.
  • Affordable & Transparent Pricing: We believe in honest billing. We process most major commercial insurance plans and are committed to a strict no balance billing policy.
  • Total Privacy & Compliance: Your medical data is strictly confidential and fully HIPAA-compliant. We offer discreet processing for infectious diseases and specialized panels.
  Call Us Now

Comprehensive ER Laboratory Testing

Our state-of-the-art lab is equipped to run a massive array of critical diagnostic tests to pinpoint exactly what is happening inside your body. When you are experiencing a medical emergency, rapid blood analysis is our first line of defense. Our on-site laboratory is equipped to run comprehensive emergency blood tests to instantly identify severe infections, organ failure, and metabolic crises.
  • Complete Blood Count (CBC): We instantly check your red and white blood cells to detect severe bacterial infections, acute blood loss, or dangerous immune responses.
  • Comprehensive Metabolic Panels: We evaluate your kidney function, liver health, and electrolyte balance to diagnose severe dehydration or diabetic emergencies.
  • Cardiac & Coagulation Panels: For patients with chest pain, we run immediate cardiac enzyme tests to detect active heart attacks and blood tests to rule out life-threatening blood clots.
  • Rapid Urinalysis: We rapidly analyze urine samples to detect painful urinary tract infections (UTIs), kidney stones, and severe kidney distress so we can administer IV antibiotics immediately.
If you suspect exposure to an infectious disease or are experiencing severe, painful symptoms, waiting days for a standard clinic appointment is incredibly stressful. We provide highly accurate, rapid, and completely confidential testing in a safe, private environment.
  • Comprehensive STD Panels: Our laboratory provides highly discreet, fast-acting diagnostic tests for Syphilis, Gonorrhea, Chlamydia, and HIV.
  • Rapid Viral Screening: We offer immediate testing for severe infectious diseases, including Hepatitis B and C, so you can understand your status fast.
  • Immediate Medical Intervention: Unlike a standalone commercial lab, our board-certified emergency physicians are on-site to instantly review your results and prescribe the necessary antibiotics or antiviral medications before you leave our facility.
  • Total Patient Privacy: Your medical data and test results are strictly confidential, fully HIPAA-compliant, and processed securely right here in our White Rock facility.

Advanced Diagnostic Capabilities in White Rock, TX

Our East Dallas medical team utilizes these specific laboratory tests to diagnose and treat severe medical conditions every single day:

COVID-19 & PCR Testing

COVID-19 & PCR Testing

We offer rapid COVID-19 testing and highly accurate PCR tests to detect active infections. Whether you have a high fever or severe respiratory symptoms, we provide definitive answers fast.

RSV & Respiratory Panels

RSV & Respiratory Panels

Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) can be dangerous, especially for young children and older adults. We provide rapid RSV testing to detect aggressive infections early and begin immediate airway management.

Cardiac Enzyme Testing

Cardiac Enzyme Testing

Unexplained chest pain is always a medical emergency. We measure specific protein levels in your blood to assess heart muscle damage and definitively diagnose a cardiac event.

Basic Metabolic Panel (BMP)

Basic Metabolic Panel (BMP)

A BMP provides a critical snapshot of your body's internal chemistry, including kidney function, blood sugar levels, and electrolyte balance. It is vital for diagnosing severe dehydration and diabetic crises.

Complete Blood Count (CBC)

Complete Blood Count (CBC)

A CBC is the foundation of emergency diagnostics. It allows our doctors to instantly detect systemic infections, severe anemia, and dangerous immune system disorders.

Liver Function Panel

Liver Function Panel

This panel checks vital liver enzymes and proteins to assess liver toxicity and detect severe conditions such as acute hepatitis, cirrhosis, and sudden organ damage.

Strep and Mono Testing

Strep and Mono Testing

Severe throat pain combined with a fever requires fast identification. We provide rapid strep tests and mono tests to diagnose the exact bacterial or viral strain causing your agony.

Advanced Urinalysis

Advanced Urinalysis

A rapid urinalysis helps us diagnose painful urinary tract infections (UTIs), kidney stones, and complex metabolic disorders so we can administer the correct IV antibiotics.

Who Relies on Our ER Laboratory Testing?

Our COLA-certified laboratory is built for speed and precision. We provide critical diagnostic answers for patients who do not have the luxury of time.
  • Patients in a Medical Crisis: If you are experiencing sudden chest pain, severe abdominal cramping, or unexplainable weakness, our laboratory provides the immediate data our doctors need to save your life.
  • Local East Dallas Families: When a child spikes a dangerously high fever or shows signs of severe respiratory illness, parents rely on our rapid viral and bacterial testing for fast peace of mind.
  • Post-Accident Evaluations: Following a severe workplace injury or motor vehicle accident, we perform comprehensive blood panels and immediate toxicology screens to ensure safe medical interventions.

How Our White Rock Laboratory Testing Works

Medical emergencies do not operate on a schedule, and neither do we. We have streamlined our laboratory process to get you evaluated and tested immediately.
  • Step 1: Walk-In 24/7 Do not wait for an appointment. Drive directly to our modern facility anytime, day or night, and experience our standard of minimal wait times.
  • Step 2: Rapid Physician Triage If you are experiencing pain or severe symptoms, our board-certified emergency doctors will evaluate you instantly to determine exactly which lab tests are required to save your life.
  • Step 3: On-Site Sample Collection Our skilled, compassionate registered nurses will draw your blood or collect necessary swabs quickly and safely in a private room.
  • Step 4: Fast, Accurate Results Your samples are walked directly to our in-house lab. Most critical test results are delivered straight to your attending physician within one hour.
Contact Us Now

Why East Dallas Trusts Our On-Site Laboratory

With a reputation for excellence, our Dallas-based laboratory testing services are trusted by thousands. We blend cutting-edge technology with a patient-first approach, ensuring top-tier service and accurate results every time.

Fast & Flawless Results

Fast & Flawless Results

We process your blood work and diagnostic swabs immediately on-site so you never wait days for critical medical answers.

Board-Certified Experts

Board-Certified Experts

Your lab results are not just processed; they are reviewed instantly by experienced emergency room physicians to guarantee immediate, accurate treatment.

Hyper-Local Convenience

Hyper-Local Convenience

Centrally located on Northwest Highway, we provide rapid access to high-tier medical testing with minimal wait times, saving you from the crowded hospital lobby.

Complete Diagnostic Power

Complete Diagnostic Power

From life-saving cardiac panels to rapid infectious disease screening, our freestanding emergency room has the advanced machinery to diagnose severe conditions instantly.

Get Fast Laboratory Results in White Rock, TX

When you need precise, rapid diagnostic testing in the White Rock, Lake Highlands, or Casa View neighborhoods, ER of White Rock is ready. Do not guess with your health. Visit our laboratory today for the answers you deserve. Call Us Now

settings.title: Why Choose ER of White Rock for Diagnostic Testing?

settings.editor:
Laboratory results help your care team assess what may be causing your symptoms. A result is one part of an evaluation, alongside your health history and examination.

  • Understand the test: Ask which tests are being ordered and what questions they may help answer.
  • Discuss the results: A result outside the reference range does not always mean you have a medical condition. A result within the range does not rule out every problem.
  • Ask about next steps: Find out whether more testing or follow-up may be needed.

See MedlinePlus guidance on understanding lab results.
